notes.title: Version 2.7.4 is now Live ! (Chinese support and more)
notes.content:
Hi !

We're proud and happy to announce that the v2.7.4 of 
Overdriven Reloaded is now Live !

Content of this version :

- Traditional Chinese support for subtitles and menus !
- Controllers index aren't linked to a player anymore.
 the first who press "join" is linked to the first available player.
- Some little performance enhancement.
- Little enhancement for the stars background on stage 1.
- Some sound and explosion fixes.


-> [WINDOWS ONLY] 
you can now change the button mapping by changing the button index in the file : 
"controllers_mapping.txt", in the main folder of the game.
(for people who want to play on their Home Made Arcade cabinet, or arcade stick).

notes.title: Update 2.4.1 is Live !
notes.content:
We are happy and proud to announce that the update 2.4.1 is now live !

Content of this new version :

- Add 4:3 fullscreen support (no blacks bars)
- Add a new TV "effect"
- Fix for some bullet pattern (more smooth now)
- In a multiplayer game, if a player is "outside" the camera, he is not killed anymore.
- General Performance improvements.
- General Sounds improvements.
- Code changes to support the incoming DLC "Special Edition - Upgrade".

DLC "Special Edition Upgrade" is coming soon ...

notes.title: Overdriven Reloaded is now available for Linux / SteamOS
notes.content:
We're happy and proud to announce :
Overdriven Reloaded is now available for Linux / SteamOS ! :)

Also, the game was updated yesterday (v2.3.6) :

- The commander Terri now speaks (voice in english).
- Some Changes in the "mini tutorial" at the start of the 1st stage. 
(now , buttons and puzzles are explained when you start the 1 st stage).
- Manic mode difficulty and bonus droprate were changed.
- some minor performance improvements.
- improved compression of assets on the HDD and in RAM.
- Minor bug fixe on the puzzle "algorithm" .
- Add visual effect and sound effect for "The One Man Army Game Studio"'s Logo at start.


Linux and Mac version only supports Xinput controllers.
Windows Version supports both Xinput and DirectInput controllers.

notes.title: Update 2.3 live !
notes.content:
- a demo is now available, let's play a bit for free ;)
- new feature : beat the best : show the global best score or your friends best score below you current score in the game.
- customization feature : choose where you want to see the bosses 's energy bar (top, bottom, right, left)
- add a special button mapping for PS4 controllers and special icons
  (in the options menu, choose "PS4 controller", no effect for X360/XB1 controllers).
- Button mapping for DirectInput "standard" controller, now on 6 buttons only.
- Difficulty readjusted for Arcade mode and Manic mode.
- Better health-bar's visibility for players and bosses .
- bugfix for "BOSS RUSH" times, which are now correctly saved.
- Continues bugfix when Terri dies in Arcade or Manic.
- Better visibility for bonuses (contour added).
- add "Stars" Hoover.
- less artifacts are required to unlock stages in Story mode.
- The font used in the Menu and for subtitles has changed : 
  add French localization, spanish and german  (beta , will be improved soon) ! 
- the default language is the OS language. ( to change it, it's possible from the options Menu).
- Enemies drop a bit more stars now .
- new graphie options : multisampling, vsync.
- general performances improvement.
